title: Silas and the Tide
author: Rosalind Delacroix
blurb: Silas Ashgrove, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
